approved_changes: Enforce declared lookahead bounds with conservative raw provisional output on exhaustion.
Remove accidental parser implementation root exports without external package callers, retaining deliberate public contracts.
Separate inline/mixed grammar policy from orchestration.
Separate worker lifetime ownership and iterator pumping from React rendering orchestration.
Separate code-block rendering owner from universal block routing.
Use canonical consumer inspector blocks rather than visibility-gated duplicate state.
Restore real server-rendered article bodies via public snapshot compilation/rendering.
guardrails: Preserve all other public APIs, mode semantics, stream identity, callbacks, native DOM/filter/security and final authored content.
Borrowed workers are never terminated; factory-created workers are owned and terminate exactly once, including managed sessions.
No blanket snapshot promotion, shims, mock fallbacks or performance claims.
Original user working copies remain untouched.
